verses.17: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again,
verses.18: They said therefore, What is this that he saith,
verses.29: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.30: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
